name: Skilled Worker Residence Permit

qualifying_event.description: For third-country nationals with a concrete job offer from a specific Norwegian employer, who meet one of the qualification tiers: 3+ years of upper-secondary vocational training, a university/college degree, or 6+ years of documented special-qualification work experience.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Job offer/employer confirmation code; qualification documents (vocational diploma, degree, or detailed employer experience certificates).

requirements.blocker_text: A concrete job offer from a specific Norwegian employer is mandatory; the employer must submit confirmation before the application can proceed.

One of: a completed 3+ year upper-secondary vocational training programme, a university/college bachelor's degree or higher, or special qualifications shown through 6+ years of documented work experience.
Minimum annual income of NOK 341,373 pre-tax, and pay/working conditions no worse than what is normal in Norway.
The employer must offer at least 80% of full-time work.

evidence_required.document: Qualification documents (vocational, degree, or experience certificates)

outcome.duration_length: up to 1 year (vocational-level roles) or up to 3 years (university-degree roles; 1 year if via a staffing agency)
outcome.physical_presence_requirement: cannot be outside Norway more than 7 months total during the 3-year qualifying period (up to 15 months for employer-sponsored travel, of which at least 8 months must be employer-sponsored)

sources.title: UDI -- Skilled workers: job offer requirement, 3 qualification tiers, NOK 341,373 salary threshold, 80% full-time employer obligation, up to 1-year (vocational) or 3-year (degree) duration, path to permanent residence after 3 years

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Norway). work_rights modeled 'restricted' since the permit is tied to the specific job/employer. Applications for vocational roles (restaurant, automotive, construction) from a defined list of countries (Bangladesh, China, India, Iran, Kosovo, Nepal, Pakistan, Turkiye, Vietnam) face heightened fraud scrutiny per the tier-1 source -- disclosed as a real-world processing caveat, not modeled as a formal eligibility gate.
